_comment: Voices the office offers. id = <engine>:<name>. role: system (the HQ's own voice), lead (AM7), crew (operational hackers), any. VoiceStudio presets are designed voices: VoxCPM2 voice design (an English description plus a fixed seed; Russian descriptions came out female-sounding) rendered once into a short reference clip (voice-refs/<file>, synthetic, no real person) that VoiceStudio then clones for every line, so the timbre never drifts. 'fallback' is the Silero voice spoken when VoiceStudio is down (all different, so the crew stays distinguishable on a CPU-only server). 'fx' is the post-processing heard on the voice, fallback included: humanoid-heavy (AM7 and the system: -4 semitones with formants kept, 6 % slower, grit, octave sub, ring-mod and metal comb, tight room) or humanoid-hard (the crew: -3 semitones, the same character lighter); the older humanoid / humanoid-light stay available. 'gender' picks the grammatical form of the crew's lines.
